description: General gameplay strategies and decision-making heuristics for smarter agents

survival.description: Staying alive is always the top priority. Flee, eat, seek shelter.

basicNeeds.description: Establish basic survival infrastructure before anything else.

progression.description: Mine better materials, upgrade tools, expand capabilities.

building.description: Build structures, improve base, create aesthetic builds.

social.description: Interact with other players or agents.

dawn.advice: Best time to leave shelter and start outdoor activities

day.advice: Maximum outdoor productivity. Mine, build, farm, explore.

dusk.advice: Return to shelter or prepare for night

night.advice: Stay in lit areas, underground mining, indoor crafting

efficiencyTips: Always carry a water bucket - prevents fall damage, puts out fires, creates obsidian
Place torches on left wall when exploring caves to find way back
Crouch to avoid falling off edges
Smelt while doing other tasks - don't wait for furnace
Strip mine at Y=-59 for diamonds, Y=16 for iron
Keep one of each tool on hotbar for quick switching
Use beds to skip night and reset spawn point
Kill passive mobs during day for food
Always have an exit strategy when mining

commonDeathCauses.prevention: Water bucket, feather falling, watch edges
Listen for hiss, sprint away, shields
Don't fight multiple mobs, light areas
Fire resistance potion, never dig straight down
Watch air bubbles, carry door for air pocket

buildingHeuristics: Start small and expand - 5x5 is a good first room
Light everything - torch every 7 blocks prevents spawns
Add depth to walls with stairs and slabs
Windows should be 2 high for good view
Roofs with overhang look more natural
Use terrain features as part of builds
collaborationStrategies: Divide tasks by specialty - one mines, one builds
Don't duplicate tool crafting - trade instead
Build bases near each other for defense
Coordinate mining operations at different Y levels
Assign building roles: foundation, walls, roof, interior
